summary: Site page re-read: 022 still listed and bookable online, Drive-In, Horse/RV/Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle and equipment length 25 ft, pull-through gravel driveway, clearance 15 ft, picnic table; count 1, 25 ft and pull_through true confirmed, sites note added. Year-round confirmed; sells in all five windows. Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; hookups and facilities none. Imagery (Esri leaf-on: closed canopy; PASDA leaf-off): a widening on the forest road's edge at the pin, which sits on it; its size cannot be measured under the trees. NHD: West Licking Creek 165 m away; not waterfront.
flags: ROAD / NAME: '(North Block)' is only the booking system's loop label. The page puts site 022 'on Licking Creek Drive, about 0.8 mi from the intersection with Blacklog Mountain Road'; the GIS notes say 'Pulloff along West Licking Creek Drive'. Suggested name: 'Tuscarora State Forest Campsite 022 (Licking Creek Drive)'. apply.py does not write names.
pull_through: the page says 'Driveway Entry: Pull-Through' and 'Campsite is a pull off'; stored true confirmed.
LENGTHS (ruling 12 check): Max Vehicle Length 25 and Equipment Length 25; the page gives no driveway length and no spur figure, so nothing disagrees.
Overhead: 'Site Height/Overhead Clearance: 15' on every page of this entry; over the 10.5-ft line, nothing to act on.

Agency access statements (ruling 11: nothing measured, no road surface, gate or bridge research): no Site Grade or Driveway Grade line on this page; gravel. No caution line. The page also carries the district-wide 'Road and Travel Alert' and '4WD vehicles may be recommended for some sites year-round, check notes' boilerplate (this site's notes say nothing about 4WD).

ATV / SNOWMOBILE / HORSE (rulings 1, 12, 13, 14): no page and no GIS record of this entry contains the words ATV, snowmobile, noise, adjacent, trailhead, parking area or equestrian; nothing ties a site to an ATV system, an ATV or snowmobile lot, or a horse camp. The Tuscarora forest pages list no ATV trail (the /atv-riding page answers 404); the snowmobile page says only 'A snowmobile trail system of more than 100 miles'. The three snowmobile maps (elibrary 4818940, 3467448, 3467452) were downloaded but their parking symbols are image-only with no text layer naming lots: UNREAD for whether a lot sits at a site.
GIS layer vs page: the layer says FireRing No, the page 'Fire Ring: Stone Fire Ring'; TrailerAccess Yes and PicnicTables Yes agree with the page.

Ground: under closed canopy on the leaf-on image; the leaf-off image shows the road with a widening at the pin. No pad dimensions are claimed from imagery. Pin stays (page GIS Details, Facility point and DCNR layer all 40.35482,-77.80043).
Water: NHD has West Licking Creek 165 m from the site, woods between; nothing within 50 m. Not waterfront, no lead.

Tuscarora advisories page (read 2026-11-10): district office construction (mid-July to early November 2025), a chronic wasting disease notice, firewood. No road closure, gate, bridge limit or timber-sale notice. The Tuscarora camping page publishes no seasonal closure or site rotation; it says only 'State forest roads do not receive winter maintenance and are not plowed --motorized, roadside camping access is not guaranteed. Travel at your own risk.' It names one equestrian area, Showaker; this entry is not in it.
